intro.text: A land known for a weed soup that is very good for you but reputedly tastes foul.
A small nation of the Fjordell Empire, next to Jaador, Hrovell and Geant, known for a healthy but reputedly foul-tasting weed soup.

description.text: Gmordsom is one of its cities.
Kathari, a large pink fruit, is grown there.
